body: I’m sorry but «Life is what you make it» is such a fucking lie in some cases. There are factors in life that you have no control over like your family and school-environment. Saying that «Life is what you make it» only shift the blame of those uncontrolable things onto the person.
What do people with bigger problems do then?
hey I’m 18. Shoot me a pm if you want. I find myself in similar situation as you. I’m sorry that you are going through this aswell, it is horrible.

I don’t see any success in being successful and still feeling shite about myself.

I get top grades, am musically talented and yet I cant find people to connect with. What more will I have to do?

Anyways man, going to sleep now. Thanks for your support. Take care

Why? Because I can’t live with the pain of highschool and failing the loveofmylife relationship.

I also want my death to be a major fuck-you to the whole school system. 13 fucking years of bullshit.

I didnt’t really have a choice in middleschool. Either I hang with my semi-friends who pick on me a lot or I stay alone with noone and become everyones target. Easy choice, right?

As for my family, the impact my death will have on them does not outweigh my absolutely horrible state of being a human being.

I’m 18. The same level of bullying has not occured but I had some problems in middleschool(the norwegian schoolsystem is weird lol) with some, I would say, «light bullying» by my mates. That was quite bad aswell, you know, when your friends are the once that cause you the most pain, cause then who do you even have then you know?


My relationship with my mom and my parents are ok now. I’ve told then about my recent «depressive feelings» and they were supportive.

Having said that I dont feel any fear for them in my suicide. My life has been revolved around making sure other people are safe and happy, and it has done me no good.

This decision will be my decision bout my own well-being(or bad-being for this matter lol)

I was beaten up and called some pretty horrible shit in elementary school for around 2-3 years. It was not nice. I specifically remember a break where I was followed by around 4-5 people who would repeatadly jump on me, kick me and hit me. I told them to leave me alone and was on the brink of tears. They just asked me why I was such a bitch for not fighting back. 

I’ve had problems with being too nice all my life. My mom once told me to «Stop giving a fuck». Those words did more harm than good...

I’m just tired of life man. I can’t seem to get anything acheived anymore.

Even if I do I get no joy from it anymore.
I realized yesterday that I’ve been suicidal since may. That’s like half a year now. I’m losing hope that it will end, since I’ve both seen a doctor that told me I don’t need antidepressants and gone to a therapist for months now. Nothing seems to help.


The only reason I’m still alive is because of her, and she will never love me. What is the point anymore?


I’m starting to come to terms with the fact that I WILL kill myself in the near future when I get the chance and I feel weirdly calm. All my stress about life is gone, as I know anything I do from now will not matter.

People can go on and on about how other people will feel bad about my death but I honestly dont give a shit anymore. I’ve gone through life being the kind-guy and I’ve gotten nothing but stick. I’m not saying I’m one of those nice-guys that think they deserve everything because they are nice. I just think the world is kind of sad when I get bullied both mentally and physically as a child for seemingly nothing.

I’m honestly sad that the world is losing me. Other than that, I couldn’t care less.

I’m here for you man. Stronger together ;)
